name: HSE
summary: An ultra-thin piezoresistive pressure-array sensor for palms, robot skin, grippers and other thickness-constrained surfaces. The detailed product table specifies normal-force and contact-position sensing, a 20 N range and a thickness-like size entry below 0.3 mm.
